text:
Unfortunately, you're not eligible for a refund. Leafy Plus is only fully refundable if you cancel within 14 days of purchase and haven't used any benefits, and using free shipping once counts as a benefit used, even though you're still inside the 14 days.

You can still cancel, but you won't get money back. Your benefits (free Standard shipping, free change-of-mind returns, the 90-day guarantee, and so on) would continue to the end of the year you've paid for.

If you think the shipping benefit was applied in error, I can escalate this to a Support Lead.
